decided: If the user switches off the setting that let the AI implement or archive a change while that work is already running, the AI saves the command's run summary without a consent value and says which setting was switched off, instead of asking the user afterwards.
alternatives: ask the user after the work has run and record that they agreed
stop without saving any record of the work
why: The work has already happened, so a question afterwards would record a consent given after the act; a run summary with no consent value is exactly what the drift check flags, so the user still sees it.
